<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import collections
def snap(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    sig=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','g','O','Y','P','M'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            sig.append((n['color'],min(rs),min(cs),n['pixels']))
    return tuple(sorted(sig))
# reset
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':54,'col':6}])
base=snap(current_frame)
print("base:", base)
cands = {
 'topdot(1,1)':(16,14),'topdot(1,2)':(16,20),'topdot(1,4)':(16,32),'topdot(1,6)':(16,44),
 'botdot(1,0)':(52,44),'orange':(34,33),
 'path_topright':(26,46),'path_right':(30,57),'path_midleft':(34,20),'path_left':(40,11),'path_botright':(44,40),
 'topbox_border_right':(20,46),'botbox_border_left':(48,42),
}
for name,(r,c) in cands.items():
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    ch = snap(current_frame)!=base
    print(f"{name} ({r},{c}): changed={ch}")
    if ch:
        print("   now:", snap(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
